main_body: A tall palm-like tree: a narrow vertical brown trunk (about 4px wide, rows 18-54) topped by a dark green frond crown (rows 0-22) with a light green highlight at the top.
top_band: Organic canopy: the light green highlight patch at rows 1-6 sits on top of the dark fronds. The canopy reads as a volume, not a flat band.
evidence: Organic kind: the crown is a clump of fronds seen from above and in front, with a lighter top and darker undersides (rows 14-22 are deep green shadow under the crown, over the trunk top). The trunk is a vertical cylinder with a flared base. There is no flat-fronted or rim-only structure. It is acceptable as an organic 3/4 tree, though the crown is a fairly symmetric star shape.

style.evidence: Next to the Beodeul references, which have rich leaf clumps in several greens, scalloped foliage edges and a root-flared trunk with bark detail, this palm is much thinner. The crown has about 4 dark greens, with large areas of near-uniform dark green and a single light patch. The trunk is a straight 4px column with only 2-3 browns and sparse dark notches, so it is a flat fill over a long stretch. Outlines are dark tinted tones, which is fine. Overall tile density is much lower than the references, and it looks sticker-like and schematic by comparison.
